notes.title: Ira Release Date Set
notes.notes:
It’s the announcement you’ve been waiting for: The full version of Ira will be available on Steam on October 3, 2023! Check out the announcement trailer on YouTube:

[previewyoutube=Og_FYqMTo3U;full][/previewyoutube]

Those of you who have played the Early Access version will be surprised to see all the new features and refinements in the finished release. If you're not playing the Early Access version, you’ve still got a chance to join the Ira community before the price goes up to $19.99 on release day. (The Early Access price of $15.99 will remain in place until October 2.) This price change was a carefully considered decision, made to represent the value of the many improvements implemented over the past two years.

Please look forward to the official release date! We think you’ll be quite happy with Ira, the game where “bullet hell meets roguelike,” on October 3rd and beyond.

notes.title: Ira Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've been very busy updating and improving Ira to get it ready for its official release, and one of the most important things we've had to work on is game balancing. 

Over the past year, we've added a lot of new features and content to the game. Because of this, we've had to revisit and re-evaluate everything we've created so far, in order to make sure that the new stuff works together with the existing stuff, and that the game is still a lot of fun for as many people as possible.

We've had to adjust weapon stats, modify perk effects, increase/decrease enemies' HP and tweak just about everything where numbers are involved! We're not ready to reveal all the updates in detail just yet, but you can definitely expect some balance changes when the finished game is finally unveiled.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40268549/3acd430d90c6d4dc9b0798cbd740f4fe3ac7c6ce.png

We'll have some new things to show you within the next couple of weeks, so please stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Version Patch Notes v0.1.1~v0.1.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40268549/231d2ff7bb6b4ff3d51c7c39b55d60e3071c9243.png

Hello, this is ABShot.

Thank you so much for the bugs, problems, and feedback you send while playing.
We will check and supplement it hard.
And in the future, we will be able to share the confirmed supplements and modifications whenever there is a version update.
Thank you.

- Bug and game issues that were confirmed as of September 7th.
1) 1) When the Gunggi's health is less than half, the phase change, if the boss is killed in the pattern of flying with the wind, it becomes impossible to move and the physical strength is worn out by hitting the ice wall.
2) The Moonlight Chaser (third round) tool tip says that six will be fired, but four will be fired.
3) The problem of not applying the power set effect of the 'Beggar's endurance'.
4) The 'Golden hammer' and 'Purified Chaos Soul Decoration' are the set effects of 'Fortification expert', but the problem is that even if it is filled with 2/2, there is no effect.
5) From the second phase of Laura, if you catch all the pawns, it will be recognized as a room clear, so you can't see the hit box in the main groin and roll indefinitely.
6) The problem of disappearing due to consumption even if a tough passive is used to prevent a double attack with 10% continuous speed of 'Steel armor'.
7) Problem that window mode operation without borders cannot be performed.
8) The problem that the discarded item remains on the map.
9) The problem of getting stuck in the base pattern during the battle of the seal stone of the apostle.


- Share the revised and supplemented items for each version.

v0.1.1

1. We modified the part where some monster shots are not affected by volume setting.


v0.1.2

1. The intro skip method was added after the start cut scene.
2. We modified the fact that the pause menu was not visible during some tutorial processes.
3. When the minimap dies with the minimap open, the minimap interface has been modified that does not turn off.
4, When using 'Adamantine Shield' and 'Bronze shield', we modified the parts that did not disappear even if they were destroyed.
5. We corrected the part where the 'MurdererBow's charging attack interface was malfunctioning.


v0.1.3

1. After Deva's death, we revised the problem of some Relics that interfered with the production process.
2. We fixed the problem that the number of clear was not counted normally.
3. We added an option to change the charge attack and avoidance key to the keyboard operation option.
4. We revised the fact that the background of the Yeon-death production looked strange.
5. We fixed the problem that some input guides on the Apostle unlock interface did not appear.
6. Even after unlock the apostle, We fixe the problem that was marked as unresolved in the book.
7. If the player is Blessed on a sliding floor, we have corrected the problem of slipping throughout the game.
8. We fixed the problem that the apostle of sealed memory confined the player.
9. We lowered the physical strength and reward of the sealed apostle.


We will continue to share it through individual posts.
I look forward to your kind cooperation. Thank you.
